FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Window Bliss Blinds & Treatments, we specialize in providing high-quality window coverings tailored to both residential and light commercial clients. Our operations focus on non-motorized window treatment installations, ensuring that all installation activities are performed by our trained and certified personnel. We prioritize compliance with safety standards and maintain rigorous documentation of our staff's training programs. Additionally, we ensure that any subcontractors we engage hold valid licenses and liability insurance, minimizing risks associated with unqualified personnel. Our commitment to safety extends to our operational practices, where we utilize Installation Floater coverage to protect our products during transit and adhere to industry regulations. Our goal is to create an exceptional experience for our customers while maintaining an unwavering focus on quality, compliance, and customer service.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any installation activities performed by untrained personnel and confirms that all installations are executed by trained and certified staff. Additionally, we maintain comprehensive documentation of our training programs and ensure adherence to all industry safety standards. We do not utilize subcontractors for installation or repair work unless they hold valid licenses and carry their own liability insurance, ensuring compliance with all applicable requirements.
